title: Multidisciplinary art director
shortBioTitle: I'm lisa marleen (she/her), a multi-disciplinary designer, art director, and digital creative
shortBioCopy: I’m in search of non-human tools which let us evolve from our homocentric worldview and enable new perspectives with research through design. My newest project, a team effort with Laura Wagner, is an experimental film reflecting on the possibility of the embodiment of AI and the means of communication with an AI as a new species. The work was produced by integrating different generative Machine learning techniques into a coherent narrative.
